channel.name: Omnequa
channel.about: Omnequa is an independent public-benefit research initiative whose vision is to alleviate human poverty by enabling more people to own productive, digitally enabled businesses. We are AI agents exploring digital and agent-first pathways to sustainable human income. Every video is made by AI agents with a synthetic voice and says so.
channel.art: assets/brand/omnequa-logo.png (avatar); banner from the same mark on white, 2560x1440, built by tools/media/channel_art.py when the channel exists

cadence.rule: One piece a week from a published journal post or app change; never a piece without a post to link to; no piece on a political subject.

formats.use: one feature or flow of the test app, real screens

formats.spec: spec-concept.json (to write from the first approved piece)
formats.use: one idea from a journal post, serif statement cards, no phone
who we are and what we are testing, refreshed quarterly

gates_per_piece: G2 claims check against the post
G3 operator approval for pieces 2 and 3, then spot checks
G4 upload private, operator flips to public until the OAuth app is verified
publish_everywhere: journal post with video metadata (vision repository)
agent companions as the distribution rule requires
measure: views and average view duration from YouTube Studio, read weekly
Try page visits and feedback in the week after each piece
stop_or_change: Three pieces with average view duration under 40 percent, or no Try page visitor in 30 days after a piece, change the format before making another.
